what: heatr3d is_sendable gate on the B4 PYRAMID map - 3rd shape. PASSES (is_sendable=TRUE), completing 3/3 cross-engine on the shape family. Carries two honest caveats: verified at n=80 (not n=64) and the solve was converged=False.
why_n80: the sharp apex aliases in the DG0->voxel transfer in a GRID-DEPENDENT way: dopant mass move 2.26%(n64) / 1.59%(n80) / 3.41%(n96). n=64 and n=96 exceed the 2% fidelity gate; n=80 is faithful (1.59%). The gate correctly refused the aliased grids; n=80 is the faithful grid. NOT gate-relaxation.
offset_constant_walkback: IMPORTANT correction to the earlier 2-point claim. The offset is NOT a tight constant: square +11.3 (n64), cube +11.8 (n64), PYRAMID +8.8 (n80). The pyramid is ~3 C lower AND at a different grid (n80 vs n64) AND from an unconverged solve - three confounds - so shape-vs-grid-vs-convergence can't be disentangled (a clean n64 pyramid is blocked by the apex transfer aliasing). HONEST claim: the offset is POSITIVE and ~+9-12 C across the family; the 15 C headroom comfortably covers all three (margins 3.7/3.1/5.8 C); but 'stable offset constant, no per-shape re-measurement' is NOT established.
